text:
Priya Nair: Quick ask — need someone to take the debrief lead for the Senior Frontend final with candidate Elena M. Tue 2024-06-25 11:00 PT. Interview is 45m; prefer immediate 15m debrief after. Need rubric anchor on system design + JS idioms.

Samir Patel: I can do debrief lead if it stays fully remote and ends by 12. Do you want me to prep a short score rubric?

Maya Kim: heads up — I have an interview right after, can I do debrief lead if we move the debrief to 11:15-11:55? :thinking_face:

Priya Nair: candidate slot is locked 11:00–11:45, so debrief must be immediate after. If Maya leads, we can split scribe duties so it's quick.

Jordan Lee: I can be scribe and capture scores in the template. Share doc and I'll paste the template now.

Priya Nair: thanks — doc link: https://docs.internal/recruiting/elena-m-debrief-template (internal). Rubric anchors: `ownership + system design = 40%`, `coding correctness = 35%`, `JS idioms = 25%`. Keep comments short bullet points.

Aisha Khan: I can cover the coding probe or jump in as backup scribe if needed. Happy to help.

interview-bot: Reminder set — 15 minutes before debrief. Calendar invite: `#interviews/FINAL-SR-FE-ElenaM` scheduled 2024-06-25T18:00Z.

Samir Patel: quick Q — do we normalize scores for remote vs onsite? Want to be consistent.

Priya Nair: yes — apply the same rubric. Add context notes for anomalies (audio dropout, time pressure, candidate late).

Maya Kim: confirmed, I will lead debrief and do a quick 15-min score sync. @Jordan Lee please paste the scribe template into the doc.

Jordan Lee: pasted snippet into the doc:
```
Score summary
- Ownership: X/10
- System design: X/10
- Coding: X/10
- JS idioms: X/10
Notes: ...
```

Priya Nair: perfect. Final ask — debrief lead, please ping me after with top 3 signals and any red flags (short bullets). Thanks :raised_hands:

interview-bot: Post-debrief checklist reminder will run 5m after meeting end to collect scores and export transcript.
